3755-4770-5223-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4699-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5477-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5477-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3499-3899-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1849-3259-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1305-1409-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1305-1409-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {1}{U}, blinking it and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk. Choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability given to it by Barbara Wright.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
When Avatar Kuruk enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn

225-1671-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
225-1671-5702-6850.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1671-5702-6850.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1651-1863-2499-2638-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1863-2499-2638-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1863-2499-2638-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1978-5056-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Forests.
1978-5056-5709.description:
Cause Rofellos to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rofellos.
Repeat from step 2.

1496-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-4017-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2866-4986-5034-5315.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sol Ring.
When Sol Ring leaves the battlefield, Scrap Trawler triggers, returning any mana value 0 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

60-5959.manaNeeded: {U/R}{U/R} plus enough mana to cast the additional sorcery
60-5959.easyPrerequisites:
You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
You have a sorcery card in hand.
60-5959.description:
Cast the additional sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Alania triggers; choose not to have an opponent draw a card.
Holding priority, cast Expansion by paying {U/R}{U/R}, targeting the additional sorcery.
Alania triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card and you to copy Expansion, with the copy targeting the original Expansion.
Resolve the copy of Expansion, copying the original Expansion, with the copy targeting the original Expansion.
Repeat step 5.

2292-2525-4681.description:
Cast Body Double by paying {4}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Body Double.
Resolve the Body Double trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 2.

1350-5287-6441.notablePrerequisites: Dihada has at least four loyalty counters on it.
1350-5287-6441.description:
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to reveal the top four cards of your library and put them into your graveyard, and create eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{W}{W}{B}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Dihada from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dihada by paying {1}{R}{W}{B}.
Repeat.

394-1445-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
394-1445-4050.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

413-1789-4452-5649.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
413-1789-4452-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Blasting Station trigger.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bladewing's Thrall trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

38-301-2744.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-301-2744.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

1651-3715-4094-5365.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1651-3715-4094-5365.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-2265-4120.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-2265-4120.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1495-2265-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

11-3584-5211.manaNeeded: {6}{R}, plus an additional {U}{U} available if you have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn
11-3584-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven lands.
11-3584-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, creating a copy of Brass's Bounty for each instant and sorcery spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve the first copy of Brass's Bounty, if applicable, creating a Treasure artifact token for each land you control.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining copy, if applicable.
If you created Treasures this way, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Brass's Bounty.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal for each instant and sorcery spell cast before it this turn, with each copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the first copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Brass's Bounty, then returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
All remaining Narset's Reversal copies made in step 7 fizzle due to having no legal target.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy made in step 8, copying Brass's Bounty and returning the original Brass's Bounty to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure artifact token for each land you control.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{R}.
Repeat.

618-1379-1558-3907.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Underworld Hermit with haste.
When the Underworld Hermit token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Underworld Hermit token and the Squirrel tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

413-2115-2615.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Offspring's Revenge triggers, exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard and creating a 1/1 copy of it with haste.
When the Tree of Perdition token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Tree of Perdition token, dealing 1 damage to the opponent whose life total was swapped.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or les life.

90-628-4929.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat step 1 until Cryptic Trilobite does not have any +1/+1 counters on it.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Cryptic Trilobite's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1387-1500-3887-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1387-1500-3887-4871.description:
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {B}.
Blood Funnel triggers, causing you to sacrifice another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Lab Rats, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token and return Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.

232-2034-2136-2178.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
232-2034-2136-2178.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When the token Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Priest of Urabrask token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Priest of Urabrask token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead use Orthion's second ability to make copies of any creature(s) you control.
